tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Main slide background (content slides).

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Second background tone: recap, exercises and resources slides.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card and table surface on paper or paper-2.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders of cards, tables and dividers.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings on paper; the dark surface of covers and section dividers.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Body text on paper, paper-2 and card (8.2:1 on paper).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Footers, captions and secondary labels on paper (5.2:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, emphasis and key terms on paper (5.0:1). Orange = 'pay attention'.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Large fills only (relationship diamonds, statement slide). Never small text.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind orange callouts and ERD relationship diamonds.

tokens.name: accent-on-ink
tokens.usage: Eyebrows and numerals on the ink surface (7.9:1).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: SQL keywords in prose, links, ERD attributes, 'correct / good practice' labels (5.7:1 on paper).

tokens.name: blue-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind blue callouts and ERD attribute ellipses.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the ink surface.

tokens.name: on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the ink surface (9.0:1).

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code block surface.

tokens.name: code-text
tokens.usage: Plain code text on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: SQL keywords on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: String and number literals on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments on code-bg (5.7:1).

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its eyebrow; inside cards.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Gap between a slide heading and its body; card padding.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Footer offset from the bottom edge; big separations.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Slide margins (1920x1080 canvas).

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Pills, small tags, table corners.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Cards and code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Level badges (Core / Stretch / Challenge).
